# Astral a

The two characters flanking the apostrophes are non-BMP letters (U+20000, U+20001), so
neither apostrophe delimits a phrase. A reader that indexes UTF-16 code units sees a lone
surrogate beside each one instead, decides it is not a letter, and invents a phrase.
